tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Window background; the outermost canvas behind every panel.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Panel background — sidebar, changes panel, graph panel, menu bar, toolbar, status bar.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised surface — dropdowns, context menus, popovers, the commit-message textarea. Pair with border-control.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row or item background on hover, before a selection is made.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Row background for a selected item when the panel is not focused.

tokens.name: accent-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Row background for a selected item while its panel has focus. Always paired with ink-inverse text, in both themes.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers only — panel separators, tree indent guides, table row hairlines. Not a control boundary; not held to the 3:1 floor.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: The boundary of an interactive control — inputs, buttons, checkboxes, dropdowns. Meets 3:1 against surface-100/200/300 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and default icon color on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text — timestamps, author names, file paths, helper copy, section labels — on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons on surface-100/200/300. Intentionally below 4.5:1 in both themes — disabled state is exempt from the text-contrast floor, matching the source Git clients this system draws its density from.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any solid accent fill — brand-solid, accent-selected-bg.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, the focus ring, and interactive icon glyphs (sync, filter-active) on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: brand-solid
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Paired with ink-inverse text.

tokens.name: brand-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover/press.

tokens.name: status-added
tokens.usage: Added-file status glyph and count, local-branch icon, on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: status-modified
tokens.usage: Modified-file status glyph and count; also the current-branch line in the commit graph (graph-1), on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: status-deleted
tokens.usage: Deleted-file status glyph, conflict marker and destructive-action text, on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: status-renamed
tokens.usage: Renamed/moved-file status glyph, on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Stash indicator and non-blocking warnings, on surface-100/200/300.

tokens.name: graph-1
tokens.usage: Commit-graph line, lane 1 — always the current branch.

tokens.name: graph-2
tokens.usage: Commit-graph line, lane 2.

tokens.name: graph-3
tokens.usage: Commit-graph line, lane 3.

tokens.name: graph-4
tokens.usage: Commit-graph line, lane 4.

tokens.name: graph-5
tokens.usage: Commit-graph line, lane 5. Lanes beyond 5 repeat from graph-1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on keyboard focus, drawn outside the control's own border on any surface. Solid, never the brand gradient — meets 3:1 on surface-100/200/300 in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-1
tokens.usage: Author-avatar fill, set 1 of 5, cycled by author. Fixed across themes so a person's color stays recognizable; always paired with ink-inverse initials, which hold ≥4.5:1 against it in both themes.

tokens.name: identity-2
tokens.usage: Author-avatar fill, set 2 of 5. See identity-1.

tokens.name: identity-3
tokens.usage: Author-avatar fill, set 3 of 5. See identity-1.

tokens.name: identity-4
tokens.usage: Author-avatar fill, set 4 of 5. See identity-1.

tokens.name: identity-5
tokens.usage: Author-avatar fill, set 5 of 5. See identity-1.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel headers — Branches / Tags, Changes, Related Items.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text — tree rows, list rows, buttons, menu items, form labels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The active branch, the selected commit's message, emphasis inside body text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary text — timestamps, authors, file paths, helper copy, placeholder text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers and section eyebrows — MESSAGE, AUTHOR, DATE, ID. Set in caps in markup, not by a text-transform token.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commit IDs, SHA hashes, diff text, branch refs shown in full (refs/heads/…).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps — icon to its badge, glyph to underline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between a row's icon, label and trailing badge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside rows, buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel content padding; gap between grouped controls in a toolbar.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections within a panel — Changes above Stashes.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between major regions — sidebar and main panel, panel and status bar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Tree rows, table rows, panel edges — the app is square by default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, checkboxes, badges, avatars' square fallback.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, context menus, popovers, cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar circles, status dots, the unread/count pill.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Pressed toolbar buttons and the title bar's bottom edge — a hint of depth, not a card shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Floating layers only — dropdown menus, context menus, the branch switcher popover.
